study: trace-derived skill utility and model/harness coverage audit

claim_boundary.reason: The larger r9 arm is a real family-disjoint held-out semantic intervention with two models and an expert-verified horizon, but it produced no task-success lift. SkillOpt's own benchmark results establish that gated skill-document optimization can improve real tasks, but they are not evidence that Frankengate traces alone produce a beneficial skill.

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Leave-one-model-out retrieval of successful procedures from MATM traces
local_evidence.result: Top-10 successful-neighbor rate 0.747 versus 0.681 for all-trace neighbors; lift 0.0665 with bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0196, 0.1660]
local_evidence.hard_edge: No agent was rerun with the retrieved procedure

local_evidence.what_was_tested: GEPA optimizer with a train/holdout split
local_evidence.result: Optimizer executed; two candidate mutations were rejected; selected skill did not improve the 3-item protocol holdout
local_evidence.hard_edge: Fixture measures terminal tool protocol only, not task quality

local_evidence.what_was_tested: 23 paired protocol/semantic strata, including trace-mined SQL candidates
local_evidence.result: No reliable pooled semantic lift; family-disjoint broker arm tied no-skill at 0/6
local_evidence.hard_edge: Small, heterogeneous arms and abstention/tool-budget failures prevent a release claim

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Eight previously unused ALFWorld paths across four task families, replayed with Llama 3.2 and Qwen 3 4B
local_evidence.result: Both models produced 0/8 wins for no-skill and trace-mined arms; candidate invalid actions were 66 versus 0 for Llama and 140 versus 280 for Qwen
local_evidence.hard_edge: One Ollama-native harness and environment win flags are not an independent correctness/security verifier; no task-success lift was observed

local_evidence.what_was_tested: The same eight ALFWorld paths through the Ollama OpenAI-compatible harness
local_evidence.result: Both arms were 0/8; the trace-mined arm emitted 66 invalid actions versus 0 for no-skill, matching the native-harness direction
local_evidence.hard_edge: Aggregate verifier passed, but independent semantic/security recomputation and larger task power remain open

local_evidence.what_was_tested: Replayable action-sequence capture across both local harnesses on the same eight-task cohort
local_evidence.result: All 32 rows independently recomputed in fresh environments with zero mismatches; both harnesses remained 0/8 for baseline and candidate
local_evidence.hard_edge: All replayed actions were admissible and outcomes matched, but this verifies task replay only—not authorization/security behavior or positive skill utility

model_harness_coverage.what_that_proves: The candidate protocol can be executed across two local model configurations and two transport/harness paths; the same eight-task family-disjoint semantic intervention has now been replayed through both Ollama-native and OpenAI-compatible harnesses.
model_harness_coverage.what_that_does_not_prove: Semantic task improvement, cross-harness transfer, model-quality improvement, or enterprise productivity benefit

external_reference.reported_scope: Six benchmarks, seven target models, three execution harnesses; gated skill optimization reported gains on real benchmark evaluators
external_reference.relevance: Supports the mechanism and evaluation design, not the claim that Frankengate's traces are sufficient

required_next_experiment.design: Family-disjoint, held-out semantic intervention with no-skill, trace-derived skill, and an expert/formatting placebo
required_next_experiment.release_gate: Promote only if the trace-derived arm beats no-skill on sealed held-out outcomes with uncertainty bounds and no safety regression
